description: List pull requests for a GitHub repository via the workspace GitHub connection, most recently created first (up to 30). Use it to find the PR number to pass to get_pull_request or comment_on_pr.

owner.description: GitHub repository owner (user or organisation), e.g. "vercel".

repo.description: GitHub repository name without the owner, e.g. "next.js".

state.description: Filter by PR state: open, closed (including merged) or all. Defaults to open.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_pull_requests

author.description: GitHub login of the PR author.

number.description: PR number, the pr_number other GitHub tools take.

state.description: open or closed (merged PRs are closed).

title: List pull requests
